name: 黃瀅瑛
objective: Manufacturing processes encompass the methods and operations by which materials are shaped, assembled, and finished to produce products that satisfy functional, dimensional, and quality requirements. This course aims to help students understand the fundamental principles of manufacturing processes and to familiarize them with various mechanical manufacturing processes, including their theoretical background, operating mechanisms, process characteristics, and practical applications.
schedule:
W01: Course announce and introduction
W02: Introduction to manufacturing processes
W03: Metal-casting processes (1)
W04: Metal-casting processes (2)
W05: Forming and shaping processes and equipment (1)
W06: Forming and shaping processes and equipment (2)
W07: Joining and assembly processes
W08: Subtractive manufacturing
W09: Midterm 
W10: Material-removal processes and machines (1)
W11: Material-removal processes and machines (2)
W12: Abrasive processes and finishing operations (1)
W13: Abrasive processes and finishing operations (2)
W14: Non-traditional machining processes (1)
W15: Non-traditional machining processes (2)
W16: Fabrication of microelectronic devices
W17: Smart manufacturing
W18: Final exam
scorePolicy:
In-class assignment(s), participation, and homework: 30% 
Midterm: 35% 
Final exam: 35%
